exposure: conventional management (CM) for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
outcome: postpartum homeostatic model assessment insulin resistance
cohort: 21 patients diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) during 24-28 weeks of gestation
finding: While there were no significant differences in glycemic control or rates of large for gestational age neonates or cesarean sections between the groups, the mobile management group had significantly lower postpartum insulin resistance, BMI, weight, and body fat percentage.
mod_finding: There were no statistically significant differences in the cesarean section rates between the conventional management group and the mobile management group.
